## Install

1. Download the DMG for your Mac: **Apple Silicon** (M1/M2/M3/M4) → `Phase-x.y.z-arm64.dmg`, **Intel** → `Phase-x.y.z.dmg`.
2. Open the DMG and drag **Phase** into **Applications**.
3. Launch it. These builds are Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple, so there is no Gatekeeper prompt to work around.

Phase stores all data locally on your Mac.
